metadata.title: The cosmic DANCe of Perseus I: Membership, phase-space structure, mass, and energy distributions

notes: No star meets the eligibility rules. The paper's “energetically unbounded” stars are unbound from their parent Perseus groups, not from the Milky Way: the internal-energy calculation uses the group mass and relative positions/velocities (T:p14-b9), and Appendix A explicitly removes the Galactic potential as constant (T:p26-b10). The group-level super-virial/unbound results (T:p22-b2, T:p24-b7) therefore do not establish Galactic-unbound candidacy. The individually named stars ζ Per and o Per are adopted as members of Alcaeus (T:p23-b3, T:p23-b6), not as Galactic unbound candidates. Individual identifiers for the 1052 members appear only in a machine-readable table that is not supplied.
